---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever you build or change any page for Khokha 330, a late-night student food stall website.
---

1. The brand name is "Khokha 330" and the tagline is "Late-night bites for LUMS legends." Show the brand name in every page header.
2. Tone of voice: friendly and casual, short sentences, light Urdu words like "yaar", "garam" and "chalo" are welcome.
3. Colours: background #FFF8EE, main colour #1F3A5F (deep blue), accent #F2A541 (mango yellow), text #2B2B2B. Use no other colours.
4. Fonts: headings use the Google font Poppins in bold; body text uses the Google font Nunito.
5. Every page has a header with the brand name and links to every page, and a footer that says "Open 8pm to 3am, near LUMS, DHA Lahore".
6. Prices are always written as "Rs 250" (never PKR, Rs. or Rs.250). Times are written as "8pm" and "3am".
7. Every menu item shows a name, a one-line description, a price and one emoji.
8. Pages must look good on a phone first, then on a laptop.
9. Keep each page in a single HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inside it. The home page is always index.html in the main folder.
10. Every form checks input before sending: names cannot be empty and phone numbers must have exactly 11 digits starting with 03. Show a friendly thank-you message after sending.
11. Never use stock photos or pictures from the internet; use emoji or simple CSS shapes instead.
